description: This file defines the Message class within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library, providing static methods for parsing, serializing, and summarizing HTTP messages, including request and response handling.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for HTTP message handling, including serialization, parsing, and summarization of HTTP request and response messages.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a PSR-7 MessageInterface object into a raw HTTP message string.

methods.name: bodySummary
methods.description: Provides a short, printable summary of the message body, with optional truncation.

methods.name: rewindBody
methods.description: Rewinds the message body stream, throwing an exception if it cannot rewind.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP message string into its components: start line, headers, and body.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP request string into a RequestInterface object.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP response string into a ResponseInterface object.

methods.name: parseRequestUri
methods.description: Constructs a URI string from a request path and headers.
